wwo.name: Sydney
wwo.method: The 1900 Health Map supplies Sydney Cove and the city blocks north of Darling Harbour. The NSW Department of Lands 1890 survey supplies the Darling Harbour head, Blackwattle Bay head, original Pyrmont Bridge corridor, Ultimo and the rail terminus, and the continuous Surry Hills–Moore Park street and reserve edges. Overlapping 1887 drawn streets and land-use features are superseded where replaced. The survey beach and wharf edge is an 1890 surface. Port works between the survey and 1900 were not reconstructed. Frontage lots and road materials outside traced footprints remain inferred.

registration.limits: Seven approximate feature matches. Independent registration of the peripheral areas is absent. Some waterfront features changed inside the date window. Stable street controls are approximate.
